One grey morning, among the kelp and broken shells, a green bottle glinted. Inside lay a brittle note, its ink faded to brown. It read simply: whoever finds this, know that you are not alone. The keeper read it twice, then a third time, feeling the weight of years lift from his shoulders. He had spent decades talking only to gulls and the wind. He corked a fresh bottle with his own reply, rowed past the breakers, and let the tide carry it onward. Somewhere, he hoped, another lonely soul would read his words and smile.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还在沉睡。街灯昏黄，照着空荡的马路，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，车灯划破薄雾。便利店的灯依旧亮着，收银员打着哈欠。远处的写字楼只剩零星几扇窗透出光，不知是加班还是失眠。送奶工骑着车，车筐里的瓶子轻轻碰撞。天边泛起淡淡的青灰色，鸟还没醒，风却先凉了。这是白昼与黑夜交接的缝隙，安静得能听见自己的心跳。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to do the rest.\n- It's like standing in a line of mirrors: each mirror shows the next, smaller one, until the last tiny one stops.\n- There's always a stopping point (the smallest case), so it doesn't go on forever."}
